name: Revenge
overview: Scripture reveals that seeking revenge is a human impulse often resulting in violence, as seen when Simeon and Levi boldly avenged their sister by slaying the males of the city (Genesis 34:25) and when Samson vowed and executed vengeance against the Philistines (Judges 15:7-8; 16:28). However, the Lord commands His people not to avenge themselves or bear grudges, but to love their neighbors, emphasizing that vengeance belongs to God alone (Leviticus 19:18; Deuteronomy 32:35). These passages underscore that personal revenge conflicts with God's will and that believers are called to forbearance, trusting God to enact justice in His timing.
